messages:
taylor: publish blocked: semver guard flagged a minor bump 1.4.2 -> 1.5.0. typegen diff shows a bunch of properties toggled from `readonly` -> non-readonly in the generated TS client. this feels generated-only, not a contract change.
ci-bot: publish-job-8122 failed: changelog.semver_check failed. Detected version diff 1.4.2 -> 1.5.0. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/8122/logs
karen: i can repro locally. the generator output changed because the build image tsconfig override dropped `useDefineForClassFields` and a tslint-to-eslint template refactor changed emitted modifiers. templates emitted differently, not the OpenAPI.
andre: so it's a build/tooling delta rather than the spec. the publish flow currently is: build SDK -> generate clients -> run changelog/semver -> publish. since generation runs under the new build image config, it leaks into the semver check.
taylor: two action items: (A) short-term: allow a maintainer override `publish/gen-template-only` for generator-only cosmetic changes, (B) medium-term: pin typegen template tsconfig in the CI image and add a normalizer that strips `readonly` before doing the semver diff.
karen: i started a tiny normalizer script to drop readonly annotations from generated types and compare normalized diffs: `scripts/normalize-generated --strip-readonly dist/types.ts` — it reduces noise in diffs. i'll open a typegen PR.
andre: i'll open infra MR to pin tsconfig in the generator build image so we don't unintentionally change emitted syntax. also adding a CI check to run `npm run gen` with both current and pinned tsconfigs and fail if outputs differ.
devex-bot: artifacts for job 8122 preserved at s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/publish/8122. Sample diff excerpt: `- readonly id?: string;` `+ id?: string;`
ci-bot: note: apply label `publish/gen-template-only` to override semver guard; requires approval by release-lead.
taylor: thanks. please keep overrides rare. can we also add a semver-guard rule that treats `readonly` removal from generated declarations as non-breaking when there is no runtime behavioral change?
karen: yes, PR #501 on typegen will emit a normalized-diff marker ("normalized-only: readonly-strip") and unit tests. infra MR #889 pins tsconfig. release-playbook will get a one-line note about the override label.
andre: if someone needs to proceed with the release now, apply the label and post justification in #releases. i'll queue the two PRs for review this morning.
taylor: and add a short unit in the generator CI: `expect(normalize(a) === normalize(b))` for last-released-client vs newly-generated. that should catch any accidental toolchain drift.
devex-bot: ack. Label `publish/gen-template-only` created on repo settings.
ci-bot: publish unblocked if label applied.
taylor: great work — once both PRs land we should be safe for next week's release window. :thumbsup:
